description: Upgrade your home network with the Jio AX3000 WiFi 6 Router, designed for modern Indian homes with multiple devices and high-speed internet needs. Enjoy ultra-fast dual-band speeds up to 3000 Mbps for smooth streaming, gaming and video calls without interruptions. With coverage up to 1500 sq.ft, it ensures reliable connectivity across multiple rooms, making it ideal for 2–3 BHK homes. The router is built to handle 100+ connected devices efficiently using advanced WiFi 6 technologies like OFDMA and MU-MIMO, ensuring stable performance even during peak usage. Works seamlessly with all major broadband ISPs including JioFiber, Airtel, ACT and BSNL. With support for PPPoE, DHCP and Static IP connections, it eliminates common compatibility issues seen in basic routers. Set up and manage your network easily using the JioHome app. With WPA3 security and mesh-ready capability, you can expand your coverage and keep your home network secure.
